notes.title: Free to Play and Open Sourced
notes.notes:
Snails will be available as a Free to Play game on Steam in the upcoming week or two.

As a celebration for the 10th anniversary, we have decided to release the game for Free and Open Source the game's engine and tools for learning purposes. We hope with the release of our tools it will encourage the game to be modded with new exciting levels to be beaten.

Stay tuned and I hope you enjoyed the announcement.
